categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of printing and copying electrostatic imaging consumables and imaging equipment. Its main products include toner, OPC drums, information security copiers, and special precision machining products. Toner and OPC drums are core consumables for printers, copiers, and multifunction devices. The company also provides special precision machining parts mainly for military equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has mastered key technologies including OPC drum base processing, coating formulas, synthesis of charge generating materials (CGM) and charge transport materials (CTM), and automated coating production line integration. Toner production involves physical methods with stable quality adaptable to various environmental conditions. The company also develops information security copiers with embedded security management systems and is advancing SOC chip-based control circuit boards. It emphasizes continuous R&D with a dedicated team and collaborations with research institutes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, military, military-industrial units, enterprises, and institutions requiring information security. The company serves domestic and international markets including China, Europe, North America, South America, and Southeast Asia. Its products are widely used in mainstream printer and copier brands globally. The company also supplies OEM markets and has stable long-term relationships with numerous clients worldwide.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China with headquarters and production facilities in Hebei Province. It has a global market presence with exports to Europe, North America, South America, and Southeast Asia. Its products are adapted to diverse climatic conditions across these regions. The company’s subsidiaries also operate in Fujian Province and other locations within China.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the printing consumables supply chain, producing core consumable components like toner and OPC drums. It also manufactures finished imaging equipment such as information security copiers. It procures raw materials from domestic and international suppliers and sells products directly to customers and distributors, including OEM partnerships.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include leading industry development and supporting national strategies by promoting domestic substitution and industrial upgrading of printing consumables. The company focuses on developing autonomous, secure, efficient printing and copying equipment and consumables, enhancing information security applications, and expanding product lines such as color toner and long-life OPC drums. It invests heavily in R&D, collaborates with academic and research institutions, and pursues innovation in product quality, cost reduction, and new technologies like SOC chips for security copiers.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through direct sales of products including toner, OPC drums, information security copiers, and precision machining parts. The company uses direct sales and distribution channels, including OEM and private label manufacturing. It also receives government subsidies and other operating income. The revenue is mainly from product sales with some income from services related to product support and customization.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the leading domestic manufacturers of black toner and OPC drums, recognized as a key player in the Chinese printing consumables industry. It has a strong brand reputation as a national brand and has achieved significant market share domestically and internationally. The company competes with both domestic and international suppliers, leveraging its technological capabilities and product matching advantages to maintain competitiveness. Market consolidation favors larger, quality-focused manufacturers like this company.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.18 billion, a 10.5% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 123.9 million, up 29.9%. Total assets reached RMB 1.6 billion with net assets of RMB 1.42 billion. The company has shown steady growth in revenue, profitability, and cash flow, supported by increased R&D investment and market expansion. It maintains a solid financial position with positive operating cash flow and manageable liabilities.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its technological leadership in producing high-quality, stable, and widely compatible toner and OPC drums that perform well under diverse environmental conditions. It highlights its status as a pioneer in domestic substitution of imported consumables, strong R&D capabilities, and comprehensive product range covering mainstream printer models. Its information security copiers cater to sensitive government and military sectors, offering enhanced confidentiality features. The company leverages scale economies, quality control, and product matching advantages to offer cost-effective, reliable products with strong brand recognition.
